So, it's very important to not just try to finish the chapters according to not fall behind the syllabus, but really teach them. Personally, I think this is the biggest issue in Bilkent University overall, the professors just say we have to finish this in this lecture because we are behind the schedule. I mean the point here in university is not just finishing something, it's learning a subject well enough so we can use them in real life. I love math, and physics, so I try my best to keep up with stuff. However, the education system here is not the way I expected. I mostly learn the subjects after the midterms, and get low grades in midterms. Because we don't have enough time to really digest and learn the contents.
